text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to amend the Municipal Code, Chapter 950, Schedule 27, Compulsory Stops, to reflect a stop control for northbound traffic on George Brownlee Court at Ypres Road, which was installed by the developer under site plan approval of the new development.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized a compulsory stop control for northbound traffic on George Brownlee Court at Ypres Road.
